rationale: No existing Playwright spec touches the LLM Providers settings surface (Settings > LLM Providers, route /web/settings/llm_providers; data-test='llm-providers-*'). A full grep of tests/ for 'llm-providers|llmProviders|LlmProviders|llm_providers' returns nothing. The closest specs are GeneralTests settings-form-validation.spec.js and model-pricing.spec.js, which cover sibling Settings forms (OrganizationSettings/ModelPricing) but not LLM providers. The feature (new provider types vllm/openai_compatible + conditional API-key-required marker + key-preserving edit) is entirely uncovered, and it is a distinct product surface (enterprise-only, gated by the onlineEvals flag), so a brand-new spec file + page object is warranted rather than appending to an unrelated settings spec. Registration is required: the Engineer must add a new 'OnlineEvals' shard (testfolder + actual_folder 'OnlineEvals', run_files ['llmProviderTypes.spec.js']) to the ci-matrix. Because the feature is enterprise-gated (navGroups.ts line 37: llmProviders visible only when (isEnterprise || isCloud) && onlineEvals), the spec must gate itself with a runtime enterprise probe and test.skip on OSS (mirroring settings-form-validation.spec.js). Follow the enterprise-only precedent: if a separate enterprise overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) is where enterprise-only shards live (Workflows/SDR), register there as a 'shards' entry; otherwise add the shard to tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json and rely on the in-spec skip. Confirm with the CI owner which manifest holds enterprise-only shards for this tree.
